+def ledger(data):

+        rank = (event.get("revision", 0), position)

+            winners[event_id] = (rank, event)
+
+    balances = dict(data.get("opening", {}))
+    mode = data["rounding"]
+
+    def rounded(numerator):
+        if mode == "half_up":
+            return (numerator + 5000) // 10000
+        return numerator // 10000

+    for _, event in winners.values():
